title: December, 2010
logline: Does Chloe come home. She comes to the garage. First time she's seen it. She stays four minutes and looks at the corkboard.

panels.composition: The garage door, open. CHLOE in the doorway, Portland coat, looking in. She has never been here. WOOD at the table. BARNABY not getting up, which she notices.

image.prompt: a woman with short dark hair in a good winter coat standing in the open doorway of a cluttered garage studio looking in, a thin man at a drafting table, an old dog in a bed not getting up, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: Chloe at the corkboard. Reading it. Her own postcards. The two pinned writing-out. The bus schedule. The letter. The program.

image.prompt: a woman standing close to a crowded corkboard reading it: postcards, a bus schedule, an old letter, a folded program, no words

panels.composition: Chloe's hand touching the folded cream program. Not opening it. She knows.

image.prompt: close-up of a woman's hand resting on a folded cream program pinned to a corkboard, not opening it

panels.composition: Chloe crouching to the dog bed. The dog's tail, once. Wood watching from the table. Four minutes. The strip gives her four panels.

image.prompt: a woman crouched beside an old dog's bed in a garage as the dog's tail moves once, a man watching from his drafting table, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Chloe in the garage. The program. 'Me. He tells me.' Four panels for four minutes.
